canonical.title: Minimum Insertions to Make a String Palindrome
canonical.sourceFilePath: 14. Dynamic Programming/5. DP on Strings/05. Minimum steps to make string palindrome.cpp

narrative.title: The Palindrome Patch Ledger
narrative.scenario: A legacy router stores configuration keys that must read as palindromes for its checksum logic to accept them. Upgrades may only prepend or append characters — one insertion per step. The migration tool computes the fewest insertions that turn each legacy key into a valid palindrome before the firmware swap.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the minimum number of characters to insert (anywhere) so that s becomes a palindrome.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters

testCases.explanation: The key is already a palindrome.

hintLevels: Level 1: Characters already belonging to a palindromic motif need no insertion; the rest must be mirrored.
Level 2: The count is exactly n minus the longest palindromic subsequence length.
Level 3: Compute that motif via LCS(s, reverse(s)) — reuse the two-string table.
